_about: The golden conversation corpus (DEC-0067, docs/PERSONALITY_AND_ECOSYSTEM_AUDIT.md P5). Generic on purpose: no one's names, places or records (DEC-0002). `before` is earlier turns in the same conversation; `kind` is what the message is, for checking she read it right.
